acceptanceRule: All applicable required criteria PASS, each bound to expected/actual and hashed evidence; no unresolved Critical/Major. BLOCKED/FAIL cannot be converted to PASS by self-attestation.

criteria.name: Source integrity
criteria.passCondition: All retained PDF/API/JSON hashes and exact provenance resolve; failed requests remain visible.

criteria.name: Universe and sector
criteria.passCondition: Exactly 30 unique security IDs; effective universe/sector bindings checked; deferred members retained.

criteria.name: Scope and statement identity
criteria.passCondition: Confirm issuer, statement, consolidated/separate scope and revision directly in relevant PDF pages; mixed cover letters cannot decide statement scope.

criteria.name: Units and precision
criteria.passCondition: Confirm declared unit/currency/scale; preserve decimal strings, zero/null/dash and per-share exceptions; no guessed conversions.

criteria.name: Periods and comparability
criteria.passCondition: Separate instant/annual/quarter/YTD and current/prior columns; do not mix standalone/consolidated or annualize YTD without explicit model.

criteria.name: Required accounting coverage
criteria.passCondition: Evaluate every sector anyOf group per period with definition-qualified alternatives; do not flatten alternatives or match by amount.

criteria.name: Point-in-time
criteria.passCondition: Verify publication evidence precision; availableAt is no earlier than public boundary, retrieval, ingestion and review. Date-only uses governed conservative boundary; no backdating.

criteria.name: Market and actions
criteria.passCondition: Purpose-qualified dated prices, shares/market-cap/EV where the valuation model needs them, action adjustment and calendar/session/freshness checks.

criteria.name: Derived metrics
criteria.passCondition: Replay exact formulas with compatible scope/period/unit, operand IDs and normalized/debt qualification; denominator and cycle failures remain N/R.

criteria.name: Valuation and assumptions
criteria.passCondition: Explicit sector valuation model, conservative/base/downside assumptions and sensitivity; estimates are labelled and traced.

criteria.name: Assessment coverage
criteria.passCondition: All 23 rubric assessments and required topics have reasoned evidence and counter-evidence, with no fabricated neutral points or HUMAN attribution for AI.

criteria.name: Input and bridge equality
criteria.passCondition: Exact snapshot, methodology, source/assessment/derivation IDs; runtime-validated ScoreInput and bridge reproduce identical evidence and metrics.

criteria.name: Adversarial check
criteria.passCondition: Second checking pass reopens sources and attempts to refute producer conclusions; uses separate expected/actual records plus mutation/negative tests. This is AI self-review, not human independence.

criteria.name: Reproducibility and issue closure
criteria.passCondition: Repeatable hashes and tests; no unresolved Critical/Major issue affecting requested use. One blocked ticker does not get a fabricated score.

criteria.name: Personal AI release record
criteria.passCondition: Exact dataset hash, review tool/model/session identity where available, date and owner-authorized review mode recorded; no synthetic legacy independent reviewer.
